_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "tax_id" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prospect', "project_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "altitude_m" REAL NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_text" TEXT NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "utility_bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_period" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MXN', "tariff_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "linked_record_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roof_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NULL, "meters_per_pixel" REAL NULL, "calibration_line" TEXT NULL, "verification_line" TEXT NULL, "north_angle_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "north_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'imageUp', "magnetic_declination_deg" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roof_planes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "polygon" TEXT NOT NULL, "tilt_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tilt_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "azimuth_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 180.0, "azimuth_edge_index" INTEGER NULL, "edge_setback_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "walkways" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obstacles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "outline" TEXT NOT NULL, "center_x" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "center_y" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "width_m" REAL NOT NULL, "depth_m" REAL NULL, "rotation_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "points" TEXT NULL, "height_m" REAL NOT NULL, "height_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "tank_liters" INTEGER NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horizon_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "points" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installed_equipment" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "serial_number" TEXT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NULL, "warranty_until" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commissioning_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "tested_at" TEXT NULL, "technician" TEXT NULL, "polarity_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("polarity_ok" IN (0, 1)), "insulation_mohm" REAL NULL, "insulation_test_voltage_v" REAL NULL, "grounding_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("grounding_ok" IN (0, 1)), "grounding_ohm" REAL NULL, "labeling_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("labeling_ok" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "string_tests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "expected_voc_v" REAL NULL, "measured_voc_v" REAL NULL, "expected_isc_a" REAL NULL, "measured_isc_a" REAL NULL, "polarity_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("polarity_ok" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "maintenance_template_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "interval_months" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "maintenance_plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "interval_months" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_done_at" TEXT NULL, "next_due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "maintenance_visits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "visit_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "technician" TEXT NULL, "done_item_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "production_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "expected_kwh" REAL NULL, "poa_irradiation_kwh_m2" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "production_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "system_kwp" REAL NULL, "alert_threshold_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -15.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "file_count" INTEGER NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
